about: Plain words Studio understands without a model (chat with no API key and no assistant attached). Each vibe only names packs and engine names that exist; npm run check verifies them.

vibes.say: calmer: low-energy music, no glitch seams
the cinematic pack: film grade, soft dissolves
the hormozi-bold pack with high-energy music
tighter pace: pauses over 0.3 s cut
the minimal-clean pack: hard cuts, no grade
the magazine pack: serif and sans, colour cards
the aigent pack with scan lines and colour split
retro: grain, scan lines, warm grade
